description: Guilds: detail. WHEN: open one guild — public view without a key (name, [TAG], crest, founder, member list, treasury, guild-match wins, recent guild matches); pass a guild member's ark_ key for full detail (charter, member roles, open invites/applications, ledger tail, and optional bot tag/reputation). Read-only. Example: guild_detail {"guild_id":"<guild_id>"}

bot.description: Optional bot handle (member view): returns member_tag + reputation for that bot.

guild_id.description: Guild id returned by guild_create / guild_directory.

key.description: Optional ark_ key (public view without a key; guild member key shows full detail).
